subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should Workspaces adopt `state:persist` plus the two widget-state gateway methods as its durable custom-widget persistence contract?
rationale: This is a new security-sensitive plugin/browser API and stored-data surface whose permanent semantics, compatibility expectations, and ownership cannot be established by tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the state contract
options.body: Approve this API direction, correct the issue linkage, and require current-head browser and lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep custom widgets read-only
options.body: Defer or close this PR and its dependent notes work until maintainers choose a different persistence contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the state contract
recommendation.body: Approve this API direction, correct the issue linkage, and require current-head browser and lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces foundation and its sandbox, plugin, gateway, and SQLite ownership boundaries were merged through their work.
